measurement.instrumentation: off for every benchmark mode; on for test fused/certificate
measurement.clock: emscripten_get_now inside WASM; performance.now including JS marshaling/free for total
measurement.rgbE2e: same VideoFrame.copyTo planes -> owned Rust session -> checked planar_region -> float RGB encode; no redundant RGB preflight during create
measurement.copyMs: Rust metadata/layout checks plus owned plane copy; excludes JS-to-WASM copy
measurement.preflightMs: stored sample depth check plus RGB admission (or certificate/fallback); RGB E2E defers RGB admission to conversion
measurement.nativeTotal: same boundaries excluding JS-to-WASM and output-to-JS copies; includes output copy/free and session destroy
measurement.sampleCheckMs: stored sample depth check only; subset of preflightMs

fixturePreparation.realSize: 513x257 plus native-size bbb 1280x720; native-size fujioka range analysis only
